_meta.purpose: Named zones on the property. Each zone carries vertices (WGS84 [lon, lat] — schema v2), a status (draft / confirmed / flagged), and a history log of changes. Observations and plants reference zones via the zoneId field. The browse view is itself a thinking tool — looking at the whole property from above helps Mom form mental models of where things are.
_meta.vertexOrder: [lon, lat]  — GeoJSON order (x, y). NOT [lat, lon].
_meta.schemaNotes: v3 (2026-09-01): added optional `partOf` — a zoneId naming the zone this one sits INSIDE. A plain tree; a zone has at most one parent. Recorded because Paul stated the containment, NOT derived from geometry: the-green's vertices test only 60% inside the-turf, which at 16x16 m against a +/-9.1 m trace budget is consistent with slop and cannot confirm or refute containment either way. GEOMETRY PROPOSES, PAUL RULES. ⚠️ PROVISIONAL BY HIS OWN WORDS — 'at least that's the logic for now, which we can always refine down the road' [paul-stated 2026-09-01]. the-turf and the-meadow are SIBLINGS that together make the whole field; neither is the other's parent. ⭐ THE GOLF VOCABULARY WAS INVERTED AND IS NOW RETIRED except for The Green. A golf fairway is mown to 0.5-1.5"; the unmaintained ground is the ROUGH. A meadow is mown ONCE OR TWICE A YEAR; frequently mown grass is a lawn. Both words had been applied to the opposite half of the field, in opposite directions, and each read perfectly sensibly alone — the defect existed only in the aggregate. turf.json's prose was CORRECT throughout and was not rewritten; only its zoneIds moved. || v2 (2026-07-16): vertices are REAL WGS84 [lon, lat] coordinates. v1 stored fractions of the base image, which meant the record said where a zone APPEARED IN A PICTURE, not where it IS — swap the picture and every polygon moved, and the v1 base was an oblique Google Earth screenshot whose pixels can never be reconciled to a nadir map, so the v1 polygons were unsalvageable. Vertices are now independent of the basemap: a new basemap is a re-registration (update _meta.baseImage + bounds), never a redraw. Zone ids/names are preserved from v1 because plants.json and observations reference them via zoneId.
_meta.boundsNote: The georeference. Rendering maps each axis LINEARLY and INDEPENDENTLY against its own bound (lon->x, lat->y); the two axes do not share a degrees-per-pixel scale. Across this image the linear-vs-true-Mercator error is sub-centimetre — ~1000x below the imagery's own.
_meta.baseImageSource: USDA NAIP via Microsoft Planetary Computer
_meta.accuracyHonesty: ⚠️ READ THIS BEFORE TREATING ANY BOUNDARY AS A LINE. Paul, on finishing the trace (2026-08-31): 'in this picture it looks like there are a lot of shadows and that made it very hard to be exact with positioning and borders, especially with the low resolution.' That is a REAL and EXPLAINABLE limit, not carelessness — a 10 January capture at 34.5N puts the sun near 32 degrees at noon, so every tree, wall and structure throws a long shadow, and leaf-off bare branches add shadow texture over open ground. At 0.6 m/px there is no detail underneath a shadow to recover. So: these polygons record WHERE A NAME APPLIES, at the resolution of a name. They are NOT survey lines, NOT parcel boundaries, and NOT a basis for anything that turns on where an edge actually falls. The real budget is the NAIP spec (+/-20 ft) plus relief displacement at 2,959 ft plus the shadow ambiguity above — call it worse than +/-30 ft on any edge Paul could not positively see.
_meta.fold_2026_08_31: Mom's own map became canon: 16 areas named by her (2026-08-30 naming session, annotated NAIP aerial) and traced by Paul (2026-08-31, tools/area-trace.html) folded in; fairway + house KEPT per paul-stated rulings; fairway-fringe → fairway-border; parking-bank + upper-uber-wall-area retired (see _deleted). 3 LINEAR features (The Path, Upper-Uber wall, Driveway) are NOT here — the zone-save round-trip rebuilds {_meta, zones} wholesale and would silently drop any other key, so lines stayed in the plan file pending a schema v3. ⚠ CORRECTED 2026-09-04: schema v3 SHIPPED (schemaVersion 3) and added `partOf`, NOT lines — this deferral's own stated trigger has already fired and the deferral is still open. Linear features remain unrecorded here; tools/area-trace.html has had line support since badf097. Do not read the v3 clause as still-pending. FULL provenance, rulings, accuracy budget: .plans/2026-08-31-zones-traced-with-mom.json. CAPTURE TOOLS (do not lose track of these): tools/zone-capture.html (annotation/naming overlay) and tools/area-trace.html (polygon tracing against the registered basemap) — the standalone pages this map was made with; they are NOT the in-app zone editor.
_meta.sharedBorders: Adjacent zones were traced independently, by eye. Neighbouring boundaries WILL disagree by a few feet and leave slivers and overlaps between them. Do not read a gap between two zones as unclaimed ground — Paul 2026-09-04: "some do have a wall or a trail or a strip of nothing, and some don't", so a global tolerance pass would silently weld real features shut. ⚠ CORRECTED 2026-09-04: this note previously said "with no vertex snapping". That described the original trace and is no longer true of the record — 58 coordinates are now EXACTLY shared across 20 zone pairs (tracer snapping, badf097). Measure with tools/zone-topology-report.py; do not trust this sentence over the data. ⛔ Which pairs genuinely abut is NOT derivable from geometry; 23 of 49 sub-3m pairs are vertex-to-EDGE, which vertex snapping cannot close.
